Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement workbook: initial draft + evaluation lanes

Hi Tom / Lina —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched a compact engagement workbook to keep the pilot scoped and move toward a decision in ~30 days. The doc has three tabs:

- Success lanes (business metrics, technical acceptance, security/compliance)
- Week-by-week eval cadence (who does what each week)
- Procurement & go/no-go checkpoints

Link (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cENGAGEMENTWORKBOOK (stub)

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders who own decision criteria (economic buyer, security, infra)?
2) Any constraints on procurement timing (purchase order window, legal lead time)?
3) If this looks reasonable, can we lock a 30‑45 minute sync this week to walk the lanes with your team?

I've CC'd Jasmine and Marissa so we can stitch technical acceptance criteria and slide a short week0 deck into the same doc.

Attachments (stubs): [engagement_workbook_v1.gdoc], [week0-acceptance-slides.gslides]

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

I can join a walkthrough — Thurs 7/20 between 10–11am PT works for me.

Thanks Tom — putting the security acceptance lane draft below so you can paste/edit into the doc. I'll also add a technical validation checklist to the Week 1 column of the workbook.

Security / Technical acceptance (suggested bullets):
- Data residency: confirm processing region and that logs are stored in region X; provide a sample audit log snippet.
- KMS/HSM: confirm ability to bring own keys or use Redwood-managed KMS with 90-day key rotation policy.
- Access controls: RBAC configured with least-privilege roles; SSO via SAML; API keys rotated every 30 days.
- Rate limits/fallbacks: explicit handling for throttling and graceful fallback to a smaller model variant.
- Privacy assurance: data ingestion PII redaction guidelines and sample deletion flow.

I'll add those to the Security lane in the doc and attach a short slide with the Week 1 technical validation runbook.
